milestone: Finite Sylow fixed fields and original-branch degree reduction

changes: Native q : L[X], irreducibility, and divisibility replace the legacy nested branch subtype. Unused monicity is deliberately removed from the generic endpoint; an explicit monic-scope consumer retains the original use case.
The relative p-group theorem keeps its namespace/name and source hypotheses, but moves from AdjoinRootSplitBranchEmbedding to SylowFixedField.
Generic branch embedding imports only native Polynomial.Splits and AdjoinRoot. No branch wrapper, Milnor source, or independent draft is imported.
The original normal-subfield proofs and assumptions are retained. End-to-end native Sylow branch composition is in consumers, preserving lower source ownership.
source_correspondence.native_object_policy: Only theorems are added. IntermediateField, fixedField, fixingSubgroup, Sylow, AdjoinRoot, fieldRange, restrict, restrictAlgEquiv and equivMap retain their native Mathlib definitions. No new field, subgroup or branch model is maintained.
source_correspondence.review_boundary: Source correspondence and compilation are distinct; no external independent mathematical review is claimed.

scope: All fields, groups, quotients, embeddings and restrictions are native Mathlib objects; no new definitions, structures or alternate models.

The native Sylow subgroup interpolation result retains containment of the given fixing subgroup. The nearby Stacks solvable-inertia theorem assumes the intermediate extension is itself Galois and cannot replace this nonnormal-intermediate-field endpoint.
Prime-power exponents may be zero; positivity is proved only where a proper subgroup supplies it.
The literal branch consumer derives relative Galoisness from IsGalois.of_fixed_field and checks its actual AdjoinRoot degree before the strict drop.
The composed Sylow branch endpoint remains an in-package consumer, not an additional production adapter interface.
native_static_review.result: No mathematical mismatch, second model or unnecessary adapter layer found.
native_static_review.boundary: Additional static source and pinned-native-result review; no kernel replay or external peer review.

scope.statement: In a finite prime-power extension, roots and splitting of supplied polynomials of degree below the prime descend to the original intermediate field. The actual Sylow fixed field has prime-power upper degree, and in a finite Galois ambient extension its base degree is coprime to the prime, simultaneously splitting any specified finite family already split upstairs.
scope.conditions: The prime-power root argument needs finiteness over the intermediate field and an actual prime-power degree, not Galoisness. Zero polynomials, constants and zero exponents are retained. Ambient Galoisness is required only for the base-degree coprimality and simultaneous coprime-field conclusion. No infinite special-field construction or splitting claim for unspecified polynomials is made.

scope.statement: An irreducible divisor after coefficient extension admits an algebra homomorphism from its original AdjoinRoot quotient to the specified splitting overfield, and its polynomial degree is at most the degree of the original polynomial.
scope.conditions: A compatible tower of fields, a nonzero original polynomial splitting in the supplied overfield, and the literal irreducible divisor with its divisibility proof. No monicity, finite-dimensionality, Galois, characteristic or perfectness premise is required. No additional branch type is introduced.

scope.statement: In a finite Galois extension whose automorphism group is a p-group, every nontrivial intermediate field contains a normal degree-p subfield. The overgroup of its actual fixing subgroup gives the actual fixed field, and restriction inside the original intermediate field strictly decreases the remaining degree.
scope.conditions: A prime p, a finite Galois ambient field, its actual p-group of algebra automorphisms, and a nonbottom intermediate field. The normal index-p overgroup is proved from native Sylow subgroup interpolation and subgroup index results. No characteristic, perfectness or alternate field/group model is assumed.

scope.statement: A nontrivial finite field embedded into a finite Galois p-group extension contains an actual normal degree-p intermediate field with strictly smaller remaining degree. Native equivalence with the embedding range transports the fixed-field construction back into the original field.
scope.conditions: A prime p, finite-dimensional original and ambient fields, an actual algebra homomorphism into the Galois p-group ambient field, and original degree greater than one. The conclusion is an IntermediateField of the original field, not a range replacement. Composed consumers retain the literal Sylow fixed field and AdjoinRoot branch; relative Galoisness is obtained from the fixed-field theorem.

repairs: Only ColibTest.AdjoinRootSplitBranchEmbedding.every_sylow_branch gained an explicit native IsGalois.of_fixed_field local instance. No ambient Galois assumption or production source change.

registered_tree_validation.mathematical_source_identity: All eight frozen files match after removing only new Library attributes and reference imports.
